app.name: SAATHI
app.tagline: Safety Assistance & Alert Technology for Help & Intervention
app.disclaimer: SAATHI complements India's 112 (ERSS) and 181 Women Helpline. In immediate life-threatening danger, dial 112 directly.

welcome.title: Fast, discreet safety support that respects your autonomy.
welcome.subtitle: Designed to work alongside 112 and 181 without background tracking, coercive monitoring, or permanent location logs.

pillars.consentBody: Nothing is ever shared without your explicit per-contact permission. You see exactly what is shared and can revoke it anytime.
pillars.noTrackingBody: No passive background tracking, no 'track her' mode, and no permanent location history.
pillars.resilientBody: Designed for real-world network conditions with deterministic emergency paths and official helpline awareness.

login.title: Sign in to SAATHI
login.subtitle: Enter your mobile number in E.164 format to receive a one-time verification code.
login.mockNoticeBody: OTP codes are printed to the server console and shown below strictly for local testing:

home.foundationStatusBody: Manage who can receive your alerts and control every device permission from your append-only Consent Center.
home.privacyPledgeBody: SAATHI is currently idle. No location data is being collected, stored, or transmitted.
home.modalBody: Your JWT access token (15m) and refresh token (7d) are stored in httpOnly cookies inaccessible to third-party scripts. Automatic background token refresh is active.

step1.title: 1. You are always in control
step1.body: SAATHI never tracks you in the background. Information is shared only when you actively trigger an alert or check-in, and it expires automatically. In life-threatening danger, always dial 112 (ERSS) or 181 directly.

step2.title: 2. Every permission is separate and revocable
step2.body: Location, notifications, microphone, camera, and data processing are controlled independently in the Consent Center. Every grant or revocation is recorded in a transparent history ledger.

step3.title: 3. Mutual consent for Trusted Contacts
step3.body: You can invite up to 5 trusted contacts. No one receives alerts until they explicitly accept your invitation link, and you can pause or remove any contact instantly.
step3.consentPromptTitle: Required to send alerts: Core Safety Data Processing
step3.consentPromptBody: To notify your trusted contacts when you trigger an SOS or check-in, SAATHI needs your permission to process your account name, contact preferences, and active alert status. You can revoke this anytime in the Consent Center.
step3.consentCheckboxLabel: I understand and grant Core Safety Data Processing consent so SAATHI can send alerts to my accepted contacts.
step3.consentAlreadyGranted: Core Safety Data Processing consent is active.

consents.title: Consent Center
consents.subtitle: Nothing is collected or shared without your explicit permission. You can grant or revoke any permission at any time, and every change is recorded in your append-only ledger.
consents.reducedModeBody: Browser permission was declined or is unavailable on this device. SAATHI will continue to work in reduced mode using manual/SMS fallbacks without blocking emergency actions.
consents.historySubtitle: Immutable audit trail of every permission grant and revocation on your account.
consents.historyEmpty: No consent changes recorded yet. All permissions default to off.

data_processing.title: Core Safety Data Processing
data_processing.what: Your account profile, trusted contact preferences, and active alert state.
data_processing.why: Required to route SOS and check-in notifications to your accepted trusted circle.
data_processing.who: Only your accepted trusted contacts and assigned responders during an active alert.
data_processing.howLong: Retained only while your account is active; revoking stops all contact notifications immediately.

location.title: Emergency & Check-In Location
location.what: Device GPS or network coordinates during an active SOS or self-started check-in.
location.why: Helps your trusted contacts and responders find you quickly when you ask for help.
location.who: Only accepted contacts who also have 'Can see live location' enabled.
location.howLong: Captured only during an active session and expires automatically after resolution.

notifications.title: Safety Check-In Notifications
notifications.what: Browser push and local alert notifications.
notifications.why: Reminds you before a journey timer expires and confirms alert delivery status.
notifications.who: Displayed only on your own device.
notifications.howLong: Ephemeral device notifications; never stored permanently.

microphone.title: Optional Emergency Audio Clip
microphone.what: Short ambient audio recording when explicitly triggered during an SOS.
microphone.why: Provides context to responders if you cannot speak or type.
microphone.who: Only authorized emergency recipients during an active SOS.
microphone.howLong: Automatically purged after the incident expires.

camera.title: Optional Emergency Photo Capture
camera.what: Camera snapshot only when you explicitly attach one to a safety report or SOS.
camera.why: Allows documenting a vehicle number or surroundings when safe to do so.
camera.howLong: Deleted automatically upon incident expiry or at your request.

circle.title: Trusted Circle
circle.subtitle: Add up to 5 trusted friends or family members. A contact must accept your invitation link before they ever receive an alert.
circle.permissionsLegend: What this contact is allowed to receive:
circle.permLocation: Can see live location during active SOS
circle.emptyState: Your trusted circle is empty. Add up to 5 people you trust.
circle.outboxSubtitle: In development mode, SMS invitations are written to the local SQLite outbox (/api/dev/outbox). Open the link below to simulate the contact accepting or declining:

invite.title: {{inviter}} invited you to their Trusted Circle
invite.subtitle: Hello {{contact}}, review what you would receive if you accept this invitation. You do not need to create an account.
invite.whatYouReceiveTitle: If you accept, you may receive:
invite.permSosYes: Emergency SOS alerts when {{inviter}} asks for help
invite.permLocationYes: Temporary live location during an active alert
invite.privacyNotice: SAATHI never tracks you or {{inviter}} in the background. You can stop receiving alerts at any time.
invite.acceptedBody: Thank you. You are now an active member of {{inviter}}'s Trusted Circle.
invite.declinedBody: You have declined this invitation and will not receive any notifications.
invite.expiredBody: This single-use invitation link has expired or has already been responded to. Please ask your contact to send a fresh invitation if needed.

settings.title: Settings & Privacy Controls
settings.subtitle: Manage your language, appearance, consent ledger, and trusted contacts.
settings.toggleThemeBtn: Switch between Light and Dark Mode
settings.consentsLinkBody: Review or revoke location, notification, microphone, camera, and data processing permissions.
settings.circleLinkBody: Add, reorder, pause, or remove trusted contacts and check invitation statuses.
settings.onboardingLinkBody: Re-read how SAATHI protects your privacy and works alongside 112 and 181.
settings.safetyWordingBody: Discreet triggers (triple-tap, shortcut, shake, or voice) can fire by accident or fail on some devices depending on browser or operating system restrictions. SAATHI complements India's 112 (ERSS) and 181 Women Helpline and never replaces calling them directly.
settings.cancelWindowBody: Choose how many seconds you have to cancel an SOS alert before your trusted circle is notified.

pins.sectionSubtitle: PINs are hashed on the server and never stored in your browser. Your Cancel PIN and Duress PIN must be different.
pins.cancelPinDesc: Stops an accidental SOS alert during the cancel window so no one is notified.
pins.duressPinDesc: If someone forces you to cancel an alert, entering this PIN makes the screen look cancelled while SAATHI silently continues alerting your contacts and sharing location.
pins.errorMismatch: Confirmation PIN does not match. Please try again.
pins.errorMatchingPins: Cancel PIN and Duress PIN must be different. Please choose a distinct PIN.

disguise.sectionBody: Turns SAATHI's home screen, page title, and icon into a working calculator. Entering your secret key sequence reveals the real SOS screen.
disguise.requireCustomSequence: Please set and confirm your own secret unlock sequence first. Disguise mode has no default sequence.
disguise.secretSequenceLabel: Secret Unlock Sequence (min 4 characters, end with =)
disguise.secretSequenceHint: No default sequence is set. Only a salted SHA-256 hash of your sequence is stored on-device.
disguise.errorMinLength: Secret sequence must be at least 4 characters (e.g., 2580=).
disguise.errorFormat: Use calculator keys (digits and operators) and end with '='.
disguise.errorMismatch: Confirmation sequence does not match. Please re-enter both.

triggers.sectionSubtitle: Every trigger starts the same SOS cancel window. Use the Practice button on any trigger to test it harmlessly without creating a real alert.
triggers.practiceActiveBanner: Practice Mode active for {{trigger}}: Perform the trigger now. No real SOS alert will be created.
triggers.practiceSuccessBanner: Practice successful! Trigger '{{source}}' fired harmlessly — no real incident was created.
triggers.tripleTapBody: Tap the configured area 3 times within 1 second to trigger SOS.
triggers.shortcutBody: Press a key combination to trigger SOS immediately.
triggers.shakeBody: Shake your phone firmly to trigger SOS using the DeviceMotion sensor.
triggers.shakeUnsupported: Shake detection is not supported on this device or browser.
triggers.voiceExperimentalBadge: Experimental — may not work on all devices
triggers.voiceBody: Listens for your spoken code word while the app is open. Off by default and requires explicit microphone consent.
triggers.voiceUnsupported: Web Speech API is not supported on this browser. Voice trigger is unavailable.
triggers.voiceConsentStepBody: Enabling the voice code word uses your microphone in the browser to detect your phrase. Audio is processed locally by the browser's speech engine.
triggers.voiceGrantConsentBtn: I Consent to Microphone Use for Voice Trigger

sos.zeroContactsBanner: No one will be alerted yet. Add a trusted contact.
sos.buttonInstruction: Hold for 2 seconds to trigger emergency alert
sos.srHoldStarted: Holding SOS button. Keep holding for 2 seconds to trigger emergency alert.
sos.srHoldReleasedEarly: SOS hold released early. Alert was not triggered.

cancelWindow.title: Alert starting
cancelWindow.subtitle: Your trusted contacts will be notified when the countdown ends. Tap Cancel below if this was accidental.
cancelWindow.pinSubtitle: Use the keypad below to cancel your alert.
cancelWindow.pinErrorRequired: Please enter your PIN to cancel.

emergencyType.title: What is happening? (Optional)
emergencyType.subtitle: Tap one if safe to do so. Skipping never delays your alert.

sharingPreview.title: Sharing Preview
sharingPreview.noContacts: No trusted contacts will be alerted yet.
sharingPreview.autoStop: Stops automatically in {{minutes}} min or when you tap I'm safe
sharingPreview.locationOff: Location is off; contacts get the alert without it
sharingPreview.locationOn: Live location sharing is active for eligible contacts

location.title: Alert Location Status
location.off: Location is off; contacts get the alert without it

live.needsActionBody: Your contacts have not acknowledged the alert yet. Tap below to call 112 immediately.
live.statusActiveBody: SAATHI is sending your emergency alert to your trusted circle right now.
live.statusNotifiedBody: Help is being notified. Your trusted contacts have been alerted.
live.statusEscalatedBody: Continuing to notify your trusted circle and emergency support.
live.statusAcknowledgedBody: Someone in your trusted circle or responder team has acknowledged your alert.
live.statusCancelledBody: Your alert was cancelled inside the window. No one was notified.
live.statusResolvedBody: Your emergency alert is now closed and location sharing has stopped.
live.statusExpiredBody: The {{minutes}}-minute alert window ended and location sharing has stopped.

error.serverUnreachableBody: We couldn't connect to SAATHI right now. Please retry or call 112 / 181 directly.

offline.statusOffline: Offline — Alerts will queue & offer SMS fallback
offline.queuedBannerText: Not sent yet. Retrying. Tap to send by SMS
offline.reauthRequiredTitle: Sign-in required to send queued alert
offline.reauthRequiredBody: Your session expired while offline. Your SOS alert is still safely queued — sign in now to deliver it, or use SMS below immediately.
offline.sendBySmsGroupBtn: Send by SMS to Priority Contacts
offline.smsFallbackHonestNote: Opening your SMS app does not automatically confirm delivery. After sending the text in your messaging app, tap below to record it.
offline.smsConfirmPrompt: Did you send the SMS in your messaging app?
offline.lowPowerBody: Disables progress animations, avoids loading map tiles, and uses text-only status updates to save battery and mobile data.
offline.lowBatterySuggestion: Battery is low ({{percent}}%). Turn on Low-Battery Mode to conserve power during an emergency.
offline.iosInstallBody: Tap the Share button in Safari, then choose 'Add to Home Screen' so SAATHI works offline.
